name: Romance
overview: The Bible presents romance as a God-ordained union where a man and woman are designed to complement and cherish one another, as seen in Genesis 2:18 and 2:24, emphasizing leaving parents to unite as one flesh. Genuine love motivates devotion, exemplified by Jacob’s willing service for Rachel (Genesis 29:20). Scripture upholds faithfulness within marriage, forbidding adultery (Exodus 20:14), and celebrates rejoicing in the spouse of one’s youth (Proverbs 5:18) along with honoring a virtuous woman whose worth surpasses riches (Proverbs 31:10).
